PetroVietnam Technical Services Corp Reports Steady Trade Figures in UAE Operations

PetroVietnam Technical Services Corp, a key player in the Oil & Gas Services & Equip sector, has reported routine trade figures for its United Arab Emirates operations, underscoring a steady performance in the first half of 2024. According to data released on Monday, the company’s contract volumes and service deliveries remain consistent with previous quarters, reflecting stable demand in the region’s energy infrastructure sector.

Company officials noted that project execution timelines have been maintained without significant delays, with the majority of ongoing contracts progressing in line with expectations. “We continue to see a healthy pipeline of maintenance and technical service work in Abu Dhabi and Sharjah, with client feedback on schedule adherence and safety compliance remaining very strong,” said Nguyen Tuan Minh, regional director for the Middle East.

Industry analysts point to the UAE’s sustained investment in oil and gas infrastructure as a key factor supporting service providers. “Routine figures from PetroVietnam Technical Services Corp align with the broader market trend, where stable crude prices and government-backed projects are ensuring a steady flow of work for technical contractors,” commented Yasir Al-Dhaheri, an analyst at the Gulf Energy Research Institute.

The company reported no major equipment shortages or workforce constraints, and union representatives confirmed that site operations are proceeding without interruption. According to the UAE Oil & Gas Trade Association, sector-wide activity levels are expected to remain robust through the remainder of the year, supported by ongoing field upgrades and scheduled maintenance programs.

PetroVietnam Technical Services Corp is expected to provide its next quarterly update in September.
